Black Road Runaround#001.src: 'Ey, there, kid! I heard ol' Enkser gave ya yer first horse! That feller's a tight one, so consider it lucky ya got it fer free.
Black Road Runaround#001.dst: 어이, 거기 꼬마! Enkser 영감이 너한테 첫 말을 줬다믄서! 그 양반 짠돌이라, 공짜로 받은 걸 운 좋은 줄 알어.
Black Road Runaround#001.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#002.src: Say, d'ya wanna play a little game to get more familiar with yer steed? 's called a Time Trial.
Black Road Runaround#002.dst: 있잖여, 네 말이랑 좀 더 친해지게 작은 놀이 하나 해 볼텨? 타임 트라이얼이라는 거여.
Black Road Runaround#002.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#003.src: I've made a track 'round the local area. A few folks've tried it out, includin' Enkser, who holds the record. Him and 'is Betty're a force t'be reckoned with, I tells ya.
Black Road Runaround#003.dst: 이 근방을 한 바퀴 도는 코스를 만들어 놨지. 몇 사람이 달려 봤는디, 기록 보유자인 Enkser도 있었어. 그 양반하고 Betty는 진짜 만만찮은 상대라니께.
Black Road Runaround#003.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#004.src: Dependin' on yer time, y'can get different rewards. Emeralds, gear, and if ya beat Enkser's time (A-Rank), even another horse! It's a bet he made.
Black Road Runaround#004.dst: 기록에 따라 받는 보상이 달라. 에메랄드, 장비, 그리고 Enkser 기록 (A 랭크)을 깨면 말을 한 마리 더 받을 수 있지! 그 양반이 건 내기여.
Black Road Runaround#004.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#005.src: Best of all, it'll help make yer steed stronger. So how about it, kid? Want to try it out? If you do, talk to me again.
Black Road Runaround#005.dst: 무엇보다 네 말이 더 강해지는 데 도움이 될 거여. 그래서 어뗘, 꼬마? 한번 해 볼텨? 할 거면 나한테 다시 말 걸어.
Black Road Runaround#005.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#006.src: It's a note from Enkser... Read it?

Black Road Runaround#007.src: Welp, I'm a man of my word. I lost the bet, so to the victor go the spoils - the daughter of my precious Betty. You take good care of her, hear?

Black Road Runaround#008.src: I suspect you might be wanting to breed her with that other horse I gave you before. It's a good idea; their offspring will have a higher Potential.

Black Road Runaround#009.src: A Mount's Potential is basically the sum of all of its Max stats. The higher the Potential, the greater your horse can become.

Black Road Runaround#010.src: If you want to breed a mount, just go to the mount feeder and place the saddle of one mount into the other's trough. Yes, it's weird. Don't ask.

Black Road Runaround#011.src: Be warned though - in the process of becoming parents, the two horses you had before will have to retire. We'll take them into our care, and you'll not be able to use them anymore.

Black Road Runaround#012.src: That should be all. If you have any more questions, I left you a book about Mount rearing in the Bank across from the Enclosure. Be good to that horse for me, okay?
